title: Genuine family call about money
blurb: Her grandson calls from college: he needs money for a hostel fee, says take your time, and will send the receipt — everything a scammer never does.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Ajji, it's Rohan. How are you? Did you take your medicines today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rohan! Yes yes, I took them. How are your classes?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Going well. Ajji, one small thing. The hostel mess fee for this semester is due next week, 18 thousand. Dad said to ask you because he's travelling.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Of course, beta. How do I send it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No hurry at all, it's due next Friday. You can send it to my usual SBI account, the one you sent Diwali money to. Or I can come home this weekend and we can do it together at the bank.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Come home this weekend, I'll make your favourite bisi bele bath.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Deal. And I'll show you the fee receipt from the college portal so you can see where it went.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You're a good boy. Is the hostel food okay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's fine, Ajji, but nothing like yours. Okay, I have a lab now. I'll call you Sunday morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Call from your own number only, okay?

source: authored for evaluation (paraphrased from public advisories)
